props.text: Tuition for SEE, and for Class 11 and 12 Science and Management under NEB. We test every Friday and send you the marks on Viber on Sunday.

items.title: SEE preparation
items.text: Maths, science, English, Nepali and social. Model questions from the last ten years of SEE papers.

items.title: Class 11 and 12 Science
items.text: Physics, chemistry, maths and biology, with a lab session every second Saturday.

items.title: Class 11 and 12 Management
items.text: Accountancy, economics, business studies and English.

items.title: IOE and CEE crash course
items.text: Sixteen weeks, Sunday to Friday evenings, with mock tests in the exam format.

image.alt: Students sitting at desks listening to a teacher standing at the front

props.heading: A Friday test, a Sunday message
props.body:
Every student sits a forty-minute test each Friday. Sunday morning, parents get the marks, the class average and one line from the teacher on what to fix.

Students below 50 in a subject get a free Saturday doubt class until they are not.

items.title: New batches begin
items.text: After SEE results and the Class 11 admission lists.

items.title: Dashain break
items.text: Ten days off, revision sheet sent home.

items.title: Final revision
items.text: Extra evening classes, no extra fee.

props.title: Visit a class before you decide
props.text: Sit in on one session, free, any weekday at 4 pm.

items.q: How many students are in a batch?
items.a: Eighteen at most. When a batch is full we open the next timing, we do not add chairs.

items.q: Can my child join in the middle of the year?
items.a: Yes. We do a short placement test on the first day and send you a catch-up plan.
Printed notes for every chapter, included in the fee. Textbooks are not included.
Cash at the office, or eSewa and Fonepay to the centre QR, by the 7th of each month.
